tha-ap405:1.1: Mettagū.] Himavantass' avidūre Asoko nāma pabbato / tatthāsi assamo mayhaṃ Vissakammena māpito. // //
tha-ap405:2.1: Sumedho nāma sambuddho aggo kāruṇiko muni / nivāsayitvā pubbanhe piṇḍāya me upāgami. // //
tha-ap405:3.1: Upāgataṃ mahāvīram Sumedhaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / paggayha subhakaṃ pattaṃ sappitelam apūrayiṃ. // //
tha-ap405:4.1: Datvān' ahaṃ Buddhaseṭṭhe Sumedhe lokanāyake / añjaliṃ paggahetvāna bhīyyo hāsaṃ janes' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap405:5.1: Iminā sappidānena cetanāpanidhīhi ca / devabhūto manusso vā labhāmi vipulaṃ sukhaṃ. // //
tha-ap405:6.1: Vinipātaṃ vivajjetvā {saṃsarāmi} bhavābhave / tattha cittaṃ paṇidhitvā labhāmi acalaṃ padaṃ. // //
tha-ap405:7.1: Lābhā tuyhaṃ suladdhan te yaṃ mam addakkhi brāhmaṇo / mama dassanam āgamma arahā tvaṃ bhavissasi. // //
tha-ap405:8.1: Vissaṭṭho hohi; mā bhāyi adhigantvā mahāyasaṃ / mamaṃ hi sappiṃ datvāna parimokkhasi jātiyā. // //
tha-ap405:10.1: Iminā sappidānena mettacittavatāya ca / aṭṭhārase kappasate devaloke ramissasi. // //
tha-ap405:11.1: Aṭṭhārase ca kkhattuṃ tvaṃ devarājā bhavissasi / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
tha-ap405:12.1: Ekapaññāsakkhattuṃ ca cakkavattī bhavissasi / caturanto vijitāvī jambusaṇḍassa issaro. // //
tha-ap405:13.1: Mahāsamuddo va 'kkhobho duddharo pathavī yathā / evameva ca te bhogā appameyyā bhavissare. // //
tha-ap405:14.1: Saṭṭhikoṭī hiraññassa datvāna pabbajiṃ ahaṃ / kiṃ kusalaṃ gavesanto Bāvarim upasaṅkamiṃ. // //
tha-ap405:15.1: Tattha mante adhīyāmi chalaṅgaṃ nāma lakkhaṇaṃ / tam andhakāraṃ vidhamam uppajji tvaṃ mahāmuni. // //
tha-ap405:16.1: Tava dassanakāmo 'haṃ āgato 'mhi mahāmune / tava dhammaṃ suṇitvāna patto 'mhi acalaṃ padaṃ. // //
tha-ap405:17.1: Tiṃsakappasahassamhi sappiṃ Buddhass'adās' ahaṃ / etthantare nābhijāne sappiṃ viññāpitaṃ mayā. // //
tha-ap405:18.1: Mama saṅkappam aññāya uppajjati yadicchakaṃ / cittam aññāya nibbattaṃ sabbe santappayām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap405:19.1: Aho Buddhā aho dhammā aho no satthu sampadā / thokaṃ hi sappiṃ datvāna appameyyaṃ labhām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap405:20.1: Mahāsamudde udakaṃ yāvatā Nerupassato / mama sappim upādāya kalabhāgaṃ na hessati. // //
tha-ap405:21.1: Yāvatā cakkavālassa kayiraṃtassa rāsito / mayā nivatthavatthānam okāso so na sammati. // //
tha-ap405:22.1: Pabbatarājā Himavā pavaro pi siluccayo / mamānulittagandhassa upanīyaṃ na hessati. // //
tha-ap405:23.1: Vatthaṃ gandhañ ca sappiñ ca aññaṃ vā diṭṭhadhammikaṃ / asaṅkhataṃ ca nibbānaṃ sappidānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap405:24.1: Satipaṭṭhānasayano samādhijjhānagocaro / bhojjhaṅgabhojano ajja sappidānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap405:28.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Mettagū thero i. g. a-ti.
